storyCards.headline: It Must Be Him: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Vikki Carr's "It Must Be Him" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

It Must Be Him was released in 1967.
